Absolute Value Value to compare with the content of the counter. This value is in ticks. Parameters (inout) None Parameters (out) None Return value Ocu _ Return - Type Tells the caller whether the compare match will occur (or has already occured) during the current Refence Interval, as a result of setting the new threshold value. Description Service to set the value of the channel threshold using an absolute input data. Available via Ocu.h
